feature: Phase A — In-pipeline evidence scoring (metadata attach, no behavioral change)
problem: Docs and architecture promise 'LLM reasons, scripts verify' with Evidence Scorer as an in-pipeline stage, but AgentOrchestrator.investigate() returns raw LLM suspects and score_suspect_evidence() runs only at eval time. This violates the documented invariant, wastes redundant git I/O at eval, and prevents forensics from reading grounding scores from saved reports.
proposed_solution: After the agent loop completes and suspects are parsed, run score_suspect_evidence() per suspect (fetch diff via git_provider), attach JSON-serializable scores to report.metadata['evidence_scores'], and set metadata flags indicating scoring-only (no re-rank). Update eval_metrics.evaluate_attribution() to prefer attached scores when present; fall back to live scoring only for reports without them (e.g. baselines). Defer re-ranking, confidence adjustment, and quality-gate re-entry to Phase B.
task_order: 1-docs: Update docs/agent-loop.md and docs/architecture.md — Evidence Scorer runs inside investigate(), before report return; clarify eval reuses attached scores
2-harness: Register v3-post-processing-a (P3) and v3-post-processing-b (P5, depends_on first-live-eval) in state.json
3-orchestrator: Wire score_suspect_evidence() in orchestrator.investigate() after agent loop, before BugAttributionReport return
4-eval-metrics: Update evaluate_attribution() to reuse metadata evidence_scores when present; skip redundant get_diff
5-tests: Add/extend tests in test_attribution_agent.py and test_eval_metrics.py; verify 204+ non-archive tests pass
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: docs/agent-loop.md and docs/architecture.md describe Evidence Scorer as an in-pipeline stage executed inside investigate() after the agent loop and before report emission — not eval-only

AC-2: AgentOrchestrator.investigate() calls score_suspect_evidence() for every parsed suspect and attaches results to report.metadata['evidence_scores'] as a list of dicts (commit_id, total_quotes, grounded_quotes, grounding_rate) in suspect rank order
AC-3: Suspect rank, confidence, mechanism, and evidence_quotes on report.suspects are identical to LLM-parsed values — no re-sorting, no confidence adjustment, no suspect removal
AC-4: report.metadata includes evidence_scoring_applied=true and post_processing_applied=false (explicit signal that Phase B re-rank/gate did not run)

AC-5: evaluate_attribution() uses attached metadata['evidence_scores'] when present and does not call git_provider.get_diff() for those suspects; falls back to live score_suspect_evidence() only when evidence_scores is absent (baseline reports)
AC-6: D6 evidence_grounding_rate computed from attached scores matches the rate that live re-scoring would produce on the same report (single source of truth, no drift)
AC-7: pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/_v2_archive — all 204 existing tests pass plus new tests covering orchestrator attach and eval score reuse
edge_cases: Zero suspects (budget exceeded or agent never emitted ```suspects```): investigate() returns report with suspects=[]; evidence_scores=[] or key absent; no exception
Suspect with empty evidence_quotes: attached score has total_quotes=0, grounded_quotes=0, grounding_rate=0.0
Diff unavailable (git error, missing commit, temporal bound): score_suspect_evidence returns grounding_rate=0.0 with UNVERIFIABLE per_quote; pipeline still returns report
Baseline BugAttributionReport without evidence_scores: evaluate_attribution() falls back to live scoring via git_provider — Hit@k/MRR unchanged from current behavior
Truncated diff (> DEFAULT_MAX_DIFF_CHARS): orchestrator uses same max_diff_chars as score_suspect_evidence default; eval reuse path does not re-fetch or re-truncate differently
verification_method: Run `pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/_v2_archive -q` (expect 204+ pass). Run new unit tests: (1) mock investigate() end-to-end asserts metadata['evidence_scores'] populated and suspect rank/confidence unchanged vs pre-score snapshot; (2) evaluate_attribution() with pre-attached scores asserts git_provider.get_diff not called (mock call_count=0); (3) evaluate_attribution() without attached scores asserts fallback still works. Grep docs for 'eval-only' or contradictory pipeline ordering — must be absent. Manual inspect: orchestrator has no re-sort, no confidence *=, no loop continuation after suspects parse.
